sfeColumnSystems.name: Commercial Continuous Counter-Current SFE-CC Packed Column Skid (AISI 316L / ASME Section VIII)
sfeColumnSystems.classification: Continuous Supercritical Dense Gas-Liquid Extraction Column (PED 2014/68/EU Cat IV / ASME Code)
sfeColumnSystems.packingType: Sulzer CY Structured Stainless Steel Wire Gauze (Specific Area 900 m²/m³)
sfeColumnSystems.refluxSystem: Automated Top Terpene Distillate Recirculation with Coriolis Mass Flow Control
sfeColumnSystems.separatorCascade: Triple-Stage Cascaded Expansion: Sep 1 (110 bar, 45°C) -> Sep 2 (55 bar, 22°C) -> Subcooled Liquid Recycle
sfeColumnSystems.description: Heavy-duty continuous industrial counter-current packed column skid for continuous fractionation, folding, and deterpenation of cold-pressed citrus peel oils. High-efficiency wire gauze structured packing provides true continuous droplet-film contact, driving non-polar monoterpenes into the ascending supercritical CO2 phase while retaining high-value oxygenated aldehydes, esters, and alcohols in the descending liquid raffinate.

sfeColumnSystems.name: Aseptic High-Concentration Flavor Folding & Deterpenation SFE Skid (Ultra-Clean Food Grade)
sfeColumnSystems.classification: Sanitary High-Pressure Aroma Essence Fractionation Column (3-A Sanitary Standards 63-04 / EHEDG Class I)
sfeColumnSystems.packingType: Mellapak 500X Corrugated Electropolished Sheet Metal Packing (Ra < 0.4 µm)
sfeColumnSystems.refluxSystem: Jacketed Heated Top Reflux Divider with Micro-Metering Gear Pump
sfeColumnSystems.separatorCascade: Dual-Stage Precision Pressure Let-Down with In-Line UV-Vis Spectroscopic Density Monitoring
sfeColumnSystems.description: Engineered specifically for the production of 5-fold, 10-fold, and 20-fold concentrated Valencia orange and Sicilian lemon flavor concentrates. Eliminates thermal degradation, pyrrole formation, and caramelized off-notes common in vacuum distillation by performing entire separation under gentle, non-thermal supercritical conditions (38°C to 48°C).

sfeColumnSystems.name: Commercial Continuous Hop Extract Aroma & Alpha-Acid Fractionation SFE Column
sfeColumnSystems.classification: Continuous Phytochemical Separation Skid (ASME Section VIII Div 2 / ATEX Zone 2)
sfeColumnSystems.packingType: Montz-Pak A3-500 High-Capacity Wire Gauze with Liquid Hold-up Reducers
sfeColumnSystems.refluxSystem: Multi-Port Side-Draw Rectification with Automated Pneumatic Ratio Valves
sfeColumnSystems.separatorCascade: Quad-Stage Density Gradient Depressurization with Liquid CO2 Subcooling Condenser
sfeColumnSystems.description: High-volume fractionation skid designed to fractionate raw liquid hop extracts into pure aromatic hop essential oil fractions (myrcene, humulene, caryophyllene) and debittered or alpha-acid-rich resin fractions for modern craft brewing and natural food preservative applications.

sfeColumnSystems.name: Pilot Research Modular Counter-Current SFE Column with Optical Sapphire Sight Windows
sfeColumnSystems.classification: Advanced Process Development & Supercritical Fluid Thermodynamic Modeling Column
sfeColumnSystems.packingType: Dixon Ring Micro-Random Packing (3.2 mm Stainless Steel Mesh)
sfeColumnSystems.refluxSystem: Peltier-Cooled Precision Syringe Reflux Loop with Mass Spectrometry Sampling Port
sfeColumnSystems.separatorCascade: Dual Cyclone Microliter Fraction Collectors with Gravimetric Mass Balance
sfeColumnSystems.description: Pilot-scale research platform equipped with five heated sapphire sight glasses along the column vertical axis to directly observe gas-liquid phase transitions, flooding onset, droplet dispersion, and boundary layer mass transfer phenomena in real time.

processingFeedstocks.name: Cold-Pressed Valencia Orange Peel Oil (Citrus sinensis)
processingFeedstocks.notes: Extremely susceptible to oxidative rancidity and off-flavor aldehyde conversion when exposed to heat above 50°C in conventional vacuum stills.

processingFeedstocks.name: Cold-Pressed Sicilian Femminello Lemon Oil (Citrus limon)
processingFeedstocks.notes: Citral (geranial and neral isomers) rapidly cyclizes into bitter cymene and unpleasant terpene hydrocarbons under heat and acidity.

processingFeedstocks.name: Calabrian Bergamot Peel Oil (Citrus bergamia) - Furocoumarin Removal
processingFeedstocks.targetFoldLevel: Bergapten-Free (5-MOP < 1 ppm) Food & Perfumery Grade Oil
processingFeedstocks.notes: Raw bergamot oil contains phototoxic bergapten (5-methoxypsoralen, 1,500–3,500 ppm), which triggers severe UV phytophotodermatitis unless selectively separated.

processingFeedstocks.name: Persian Tahiti Lime Peel Oil (Citrus latifolia)
processingFeedstocks.notes: High concentration of bisabolenes and sesquiterpenes requires fine-tuned CO2 density (380–420 kg/m³) to avoid premature stripping of lime character.

processingFeedstocks.name: Raw Supercritical CO2 Hop Extract (Humulus lupulus - Cascade/Citra)
processingFeedstocks.targetFoldLevel: Pure Cold-Hop Aroma Fraction (Zero Alpha-Acid Bitterness)
processingFeedstocks.notes: Contains heavy alpha-acids (humulones, 40–55%) and beta-acids (lupulones) that must remain strictly in bottom raffinate to yield clean aroma oils.

packingMaterials.name: Sulzer Chemtech CY Wire Gauze Packing (AISI 316L)
packingMaterials.description: Gold standard for supercritical counter-current fractionation. Capillary action in the fine woven wire gauze ensures 100% surface wetting even at ultra-low liquid oil spray rates, achieving superior separation height equivalent to a theoretical plate (HETP 10–15 cm).

packingMaterials.name: Mellapak 500X Corrugated Electropolished Sheet Metal
packingMaterials.description: High-capacity corrugated sheet packing designed for larger commercial columns. Offers extremely low pressure drop and high hydraulic throughput with reduced susceptibility to heavy cuticular wax fouling.

packingMaterials.name: Dixon Rings Random Gauze Mesh Packing (3.2 mm)
packingMaterials.description: Specialized high-efficiency random mesh packing utilized in pilot and narrow-diameter extraction columns where maximum theoretical stage density is paramount.

separationStages.commercialDestination: High-purity green bio-solvent, pharmaceutical terpene precursor, or industrial citrus solvent.

separationStages.primaryDischarge: Folded Concentrated Deterpenated Oil (Aldehydes, Esters, Linalool, Citral)
separationStages.commercialDestination: Premium natural beverage flavorings, confectionery extracts, cosmetic perfumes, and clean-label citrus concentrates.

separationStages.primaryDischarge: Cuticular Plant Waxes, Pigments, and Phototoxic Bergapten Crystals
separationStages.commercialDestination: Solid hazardous waste or refined bergapten-free natural citrus wax.

separationStages.primaryDischarge: Pure Liquid Terpenes Discharged at Atmospheric Valve
Purified Liquid CO2 Recycled into High-Pressure Diaphragm Injection Pump
separationStages.commercialDestination: Closed-loop recycle loop (>95% CO2 conservation efficiency).

safetyStandards.standard: ASME Boiler & Pressure Vessel Code Section VIII Div 1 & 2
safetyStandards.scope: Pressure vessel design, forged AISI 316L/316Ti wall thickness calculations, hydrotesting at 1.5x design pressure (375 bar), and dual safety relief valves.
Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS) status for essential oils, natural flavor extracts, and solvent-free citrus extracts for human consumption.
Mandatory limit of bergapten (5-MOP) < 1.0 ppm in leave-on cosmetics and food ingredients to prevent phototoxicity and DNA cross-linking under sunlight.

safetyStandards.standard: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1000 & NIOSH CO2 Permissible Exposure Limits
safetyStandards.scope: Worker atmospheric CO2 safety: 8-hr TWA limit of 5,000 ppm (0.5%), 15-min STEL of 30,000 ppm (3.0%), with automated gas alarms and pneumatic ESD shutoff.
Sanitary piping, crevice-free electropolished interior surfaces (Ra < 0.4 µm), clean-in-place (CIP) drainability, and FDA-compliant PTFE/Kalrez elastomeric seals.

operatingPresets.name: Valencia Orange 10-Fold Aroma Concentration (92 bar, 48°C, S/F 35, Reflux 1.2)
operatingPresets.notes: Optimal industrial citrus folding. Strips 95% of monoterpenes overhead into bio-solvent stream while preserving >96% of delicate octanal, decanal, and linalool in the 10-fold bottom concentrate.

operatingPresets.name: Sicilian Lemon 5-Fold Folded Oil & Citral Protection (88 bar, 44°C, S/F 28, Reflux 1.5)
operatingPresets.notes: Gentle non-thermal folding specifically calibrated to prevent citral (neral/geranial) oxidation and cyclization into cymene, yielding a vibrant, true-to-fruit cloudy beverage essence.

operatingPresets.name: Calabrian Bergamot Bergapten-Free Refining (105 bar, 50°C, S/F 45, Reflux 2.0)
operatingPresets.notes: Selectively extracts non-phototoxic linalyl acetate and linalool overhead while precipitating carcinogenic 5-MOP / bergapten into bottom wax cut (<0.5 ppm residual bergapten).

operatingPresets.name: Craft Hop Aroma Fractionation (110 bar, 42°C, S/F 40, Reflux 0.8)
operatingPresets.notes: Extracts floral myrcene, humulene, and caryophyllene aroma volatiles without carrying over bitter alpha-acids (cohumulone/humulone), producing zero-IBU dry-hop aroma extracts.

operatingPresets.name: Excessive Pressure & Column Flooding Alert (165 bar, 36°C, S/F 55, Reflux 3.5)
operatingPresets.notes: Safety diagnostic demonstration. Shows severe liquid entrainment and hydraulic flooding caused by excessive CO2 density (680 kg/m³) collapsing light/heavy phase density differential.
